thread:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Service 'inference-stream' p99 latency > 5s for last 5m in eu-west-1. SLO breach (streaming tail). Paging on-call (sara_oncall). Link: https://dash.redwood/internal/streams?span=5m

sara_oncall: on it. ack. pulling traces/dash now. anyone seeing customer-facing errors?

alex_m: saw increased 503s from one tenant's bursty workloads earlier, but I thought autoscale handled it. adding logs.

incidents-bot: Paging: sara_oncall (primary), lila_sre (second). Incident created: INC-2026-450123.

sara_oncall: quick context: p95 ~ 800ms -> 1.1s, p99 spiked to 6-8s, streaming stalls (clients reporting long pauses). No immediate host OOMs.

mike_prod: customer support flagged two customers with streaming stalls, one is high-priority (enterprise). CS pinged.

javier_infra: pulling iostat/blk stats on gpu-pool-eu-3 hosts. seeing high write latency and some cgroup writeback bursts. suspect noisy-tenant IO amplification.

lila_sre: can you dump cgroup throttling counters? maybe cgroup.io writeback is spiking.

javier_infra: pasted minimal dumps:
```
# iostat -xz 1 3
Device:         rrqm/s  wrqm/s   r/s   w/s  rKB/s  wKB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await r_await w_await svctm  %util
sda               0.00   45.00  12.00 320.00  120.00 20480.00  64.50    5.20  14.30  1.10   15.20  0.80  85.00
```

javier_infra: and cgroup bytes_written counters for tenant-42 show sustained high bursts, matched to the p99 windows.

lila_sre: sounds like a noisy neighbor IO feedback loop — streaming ops cause write amplification (checkpointing/cache flush), hitting host IO queues -> GPU stalls -> tail latency.

sara_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) prioritize customer traffic by throttling noisy tenant (tenant-42) to soft cap. 2) move some tenant inference sessions off eu-3 pool to eu-1 warm hosts. 3) temporary cgroup ioprio or blkio throttle if migration is slow. 4) notify CS about impacted customers and ETA.

alex_m: I can push a tenant throttle via control plane: `rbctl tenant throttle --tenant tenant-42 --iops 100` — will that take effect within ~30s?

javier_infra: yes, control plane update should hit the host agents quickly. I'll also prepare a `cgset` command if we need host-level enforcement:
```
sudo cgset -r blkio.throttle.write_bps_device="8:0 104857600" /sys/fs/cgroup/blkio/tenant-42
```

mike_prod: CS prepared template message. we need an ETA before contacting enterprise customer. can we get an expected mitigation window?

lila_sre: if throttle + migration starts in the next 2m, we should see p99 drop in 3-6m. streaming tail might continue until KV cache warms on new hosts.

sara_oncall: proceeding with throttle + migration. alex, please apply throttle now. javi, stand by for live `cgset` if control plane lags. lila, monitor dashboards.

alex_m: applied throttle for tenant-42 — command returned success. (23:42:12)

incidents-bot: Action logged: tenant throttle applied by alex_m at 4501236815.

javier_infra: starting live migration of 120 sessions off gpu-pool-eu-3 -> eu-1-warm. kicking off group move job: `rbctl move-sessions --from pool:eu-3 --to pool:eu-1-warm --filter tenant:tenant-42 --batch 20`

lila_sre: metrics: within 90s p95 down to ~600ms, p99 trending down from 7s -> 2.2s. streaming stall errors dropping. adding snapshot: https://dash.redwood/internal/streams/snap/4501236818

mike_prod: CS, ETA for customer message?

customer_success_bot: Draft prepared: "We observed transient streaming stalls impacting some sessions in EU. We've throttled an internal tenant and moved sessions; we expect full recovery within 10 minutes. We'll follow up with a root cause update." Approve? :eyes:

mike_prod: approve and send to enterprise contact, include mitigation steps and ETA.

alex_m: migration batches running, no host-level cgset needed so far. control plane throttle held.

javier_infra: small host hit on eu-3 still shows occasional writeback spikes but queue depth falling. looks like backlog draining.

lila_sre: update: p99 now ~1.2s, p95 ~420ms, streaming stall rate down 88% in last 4m. marking incident as partial mitigated, continuing monitoring.

sara_oncall: good. I'll keep the page open for 30 more minutes. please start a timeline + RCA stub in INC-2026-450123. we should capture: sequence of events, tenant behavior, kernel writeback amplifying streaming stalls, controls applied, and follow-ups (quota changes, longer-term IO QoS enforcement).

mike_prod: CS sent the customer note. monitoring for any replies.

alex_m: logging all commands and session IDs to the incident ticket.

javier_infra: follow-up actions I propose: 1) enforce per-tenant blkio throttles for pool eu-3 as a safety net. 2) run a nightly job to detect sustained bursty writers with automated soft-evac. 3) investigate kernel-level tuning to reduce write amplification for checkpoints.

lila_sre: agree, add a runbook step: if p99 > 3s and blkio util > 70% => auto-throttle candidate tenants and notify infra. ops_runbook_bot, can we add that rule?

ops_runbook_bot: Runbook update queued: auto-throttle rule draft created at 4501236872. Please review in /runbooks/noisy-neighbor.md

sara_oncall: handing off to lila_sre for post-mitigation monitoring and RCA. lila, you're incident lead for postmortem. I'll update on-call rotation and mark INC-2026-450123 as stabilized at 4501236875.

lila_sre: taking it. will post initial RCA timeline within 6h and include suggested config changes + follow-ups.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-450123 status: STABILIZED. Final note: mitigation by tenant throttle + session migration.

sara_oncall: thanks team. great coordination. :thumbsup:
